summary: Fiona Ma opposed UC student divestment demands from Israel in a May 2024 POLITICO interview, describing Israel as a U.S. ally. Her campaign platform covers economy, education, housing, and cannabis regulation without referencing Palestine or Israel-Palestine policy. She drew a general-election endorsement from Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club and a Support rating from California Jewish Democrats (formerly Democrats for Israel California), while CAIR Action listed her as preferred in the general phase, a tier below full endorsement.
